svg.title: Isothermal and adiabatic processes
svg.desc: (a) From the same starting point A, an isothermal expansion (PV = constant) ends at B and an adiabatic expansion (PV^γ = constant) ends at C, at the same final volume but a lower pressure: the adiabat falls more steeply, so it does less work. (b) A cycle: isothermal expansion A to B, isochoric cooling B to C, and adiabatic compression C back to A. The net work is the area between the curves.
